name: Vibe to Verified
tagline: Turn an AI patch into mergeable evidence.
description: Audits AI-generated changes by risk, runs the smallest meaningful checks, and returns a merge decision backed by evidence instead of confidence.
triggers: verify this AI-generated patch
can I merge this vibe-coded change?
stopConditions: The intended behavior is unknown
Required checks need unavailable access

name: Skill Supply Chain Auditor
tagline: Read the instructions before they read your machine.
description: Reviews Agent Skills, bundled scripts, links, and requested capabilities for hidden instructions, credential access, exfiltration, and destructive behavior before installation.
triggers: is this skill safe to install?
audit this SKILL.md repository
stopConditions: Referenced content cannot be retrieved safely
Active exploitation would be required

name: Repo X-Ray
tagline: Map an unfamiliar codebase before touching it.
description: Maps architecture, entry points, data flow, risks, and the safest change surface when a repository is unfamiliar or a task crosses modules. Skip for a known one-file edit.
triggers: where does this behavior live?
understand this unfamiliar repository
stopConditions: Two active implementations need a product decision
The investigation exceeds its agreed timebox

name: Dependency Upgrade Surgeon
tagline: Upgrade the dependency, not the risk surface.
description: Plans and executes dependency upgrades using release notes, compatibility evidence, lockfile discipline, focused migrations, and regression checks.
triggers: upgrade this package safely
migrate to the next major version
stopConditions: Release notes or target version are unavailable
The upgrade needs a product compatibility decision

name: Zero-Downtime DB Migration
tagline: Change the schema without betting the data.
description: Designs expand-contract database migrations, backfills, mixed-version safety, lock budgets, observability, and recovery before production rollout.
triggers: make this migration zero downtime
review this schema and backfill plan
stopConditions: Production schema facts are missing
Recovery requires an unapproved destructive action

name: Bug Triage
tagline: Turn a vague symptom into a tested root cause.
description: Diagnoses failures, regressions, flaky behavior, and environment-only symptoms by reproducing the issue, ranking falsifiable hypotheses, and tracing the earliest incorrect state.
triggers: why is this failing?
this test is flaky only in CI
stopConditions: Reproduction needs production data
The requested fix is outside authorized scope

name: Incident Response Investigator
tagline: Build the timeline before changing the system.
description: Investigates live incidents from logs, metrics, traces, and deploy history using a read-only-first timeline, hypothesis tree, containment options, and explicit approvals.
triggers: production is down, investigate
build a timeline from these logs and deploys
stopConditions: A production mutation needs approval
Evidence contains secrets or regulated data

name: Pull Request Reviewer
tagline: Find the defect, skip the theatre.
description: Reviews a PR, patch, staged change, or commit range for a small number of concrete regressions. Route deep security, API-contract, and test-sufficiency audits to specialist skills.
triggers: review this pull request
find bugs in these staged changes
stopConditions: The comparison base is unavailable
Generated output hides the source change

name: Security-First Review
tagline: Trace trust boundaries before checking syntax.
description: Use whenever changed code crosses auth, tenant, upload, webhook, shell, filesystem, network, secrets, or AI-tool boundaries—even if the request only says review this diff.
triggers: review this authenticated upload route
audit this webhook and tool-call flow
stopConditions: Validation would require active exploitation
The review target is outside authorized scope

name: API Contract Auditor
tagline: Catch breaking changes before consumers do.
description: Audits OpenAPI, GraphQL, protobuf, event, webhook, shared-type, validator, and generated-SDK changes across independently deployed producers and consumers.
triggers: is this OpenAPI change breaking?
review this event payload rename during rolling deploy
stopConditions: The baseline contract is unknown
External consumer behavior is unavailable

name: Test Gap Hunter
tagline: Test behavior that can actually break.
description: Use when the goal is test sufficiency, missing regression tests, weak snapshots, mocks that hide behavior, or an escaped bug—not for a general code review.
triggers: what tests are missing?
add a regression test for this escaped bug
stopConditions: The behavior delta is unknown
A required integration cannot be reproduced safely

name: Frontend Reconstruction
tagline: Rebuild a reference without losing its design logic.
description: Reconstructs an interface when a screenshot, mockup, or existing page is provided, preserving hierarchy, responsiveness, accessibility, and interaction intent. Do not use for net-new design without a reference.
triggers: rebuild this screenshot in Vue
match this existing page reference
stopConditions: Identity-critical assets are missing
References contradict each other

name: Browser Acceptance Evidence
tagline: Prove the user journey, not just the build.
description: Runs browser acceptance journeys with screenshots, console and network checks, keyboard verification, responsive states, and an auditable evidence bundle.
triggers: verify this user flow in the browser
collect acceptance evidence for this release
stopConditions: Authentication requires unavailable user action
The journey would create destructive production data

name: Release Readiness
tagline: Decide whether this change is safe to ship.
description: Use before deploy or launch to combine artifact provenance, checks, feature flags, migrations, observability, canary rollout, rollback, and owners into a GO or NO-GO decision.
triggers: is this safe to deploy?
prepare a canary and rollback checklist
stopConditions: The artifact differs from what was verified
Recovery or compensation for data change is unknown

name: Payment Callback Guardian
tagline: Make retries boring and money states correct.
description: Secures payment and refund callbacks with raw-message verification, merchant and amount checks, atomic state transitions, durable idempotency, recoverable side effects, and reconciliation.
triggers: 审查微信支付或支付宝异步回调
payment succeeded but the order did not update
stopConditions: The channel or API version is unknown
Production payment data would need an unapproved mutation

name: Mini Program Release Readiness
tagline: Turn a preview build into a defensible release.
description: Checks mini program package identity, platform configuration, privacy declarations, login and permissions, real-device journeys, review materials, rollout, and recovery before submission.
triggers: 微信小程序准备提审
audit this mini program release checklist
stopConditions: The AppID or release artifact is unknown
A production submission needs approval

name: China Mobile WebView Acceptance
tagline: Prove the H5 journey inside the app that matters.
description: Validates H5 journeys inside WeChat, Alipay, DingTalk, Feishu, and similar mobile WebViews across SDK signatures, OAuth redirects, sessions, bridges, keyboards, safe areas, and real devices.
triggers: 这个 H5 在微信内打开有问题
verify an OAuth flow inside Alipay WebView
stopConditions: The target container or entry path is unknown
No real-device evidence is available for a claimed acceptance

name: China Dev Environment Doctor
tagline: Fix the network layer without disabling trust.
description: Diagnoses package, Git, and container download failures on mainland China and enterprise networks across DNS, proxies, TLS, corporate CAs, registries, daemons, lockfiles, and native binaries.
triggers: 国内 pnpm 安装超时怎么排查
docker pull fails behind our corporate proxy
stopConditions: Credentials or corporate certificates lack a safe handoff
The only proposed workaround disables TLS or authentication

name: Spreadsheet Import Guardian
tagline: Keep messy spreadsheets from becoming silent data corruption.
description: Designs safe CSV and XLSX imports around encoding, identifier precision, dates, validation, formula injection, previews, row errors, idempotent retries, partial failure, and large-file limits.
triggers: 设计 Excel 批量导入和逐行报错
CSV import loses leading zeros and duplicates rows
stopConditions: Field or overwrite semantics are undefined
Real sensitive data would be exposed

name: Promotion Rule Verifier
tagline: Make every discount explainable down to the cent.
description: Models and verifies coupons, full-reduction offers, member discounts, flash sales, stacking, rounding, quota and inventory concurrency, plus allocation and refund behavior.
triggers: 验证满减优惠券和会员折扣叠加
refund allocation is wrong after a promotion
stopConditions: Stacking, ordering, or rounding policy is ambiguous
Production order or inventory data would need mutation

name: Chinese Product Localization
tagline: Localize the product, not only the strings.
description: Audits Simplified and Traditional Chinese product experiences across terminology, variables, dates, currency, typography, fonts, IME composition, search, privacy formats, full UI states, and accessibility.
triggers: 验收这个产品的简体中文体验
audit Chinese UI text, dates, money, and IME behavior
stopConditions: The target Chinese variant or region is unknown
Regulated wording lacks an accountable owner
